articles.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces Senate scrutiny despite Trump-backed return as CEO
articles.snippet: Congressional scrutiny will continue even as CEO returns to lead the company after his affair scandal and its national-security implications.

articles.title: Eric Trump-backed American Bitcoin secures $150 million loan against its bitcoin
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq-listed crypto miner can borrow without selling its reserves or issuing new shares, but falling BTC prices could force it to pledge more collateral.

articles.title: Trump-linked American Bitcoin secures $150M credit line from FalconX
articles.snippet: The miner can borrow against its Bitcoin to fund operations and expansion after selling about 465 BTC to cover expenses in the third quarter.

articles.title: Trump renews call for Nvidia to rehire Jensen Huang as CEO
articles.snippet: In a Truth Social post on Monday, Trump said rehiring Jensen Huang would benefit both Nvidia and the US.

articles.title: Half of wallets on Trump’s dinner list got tokens from non-US exchanges
articles.snippet: Public Citizen traced 66 of 130 qualifying wallets to exchanges that restrict US users, raising questions over who is attending Trump’s memecoin dinner on Sunday.
